readingMode: All 16 pages sequentially read including credits, contents, voting information, ten commitments and visual cover/back. Original raw whitespace retained in supplied excerpts.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Visually read cover: ten BNG commitments in easy-reading format, general election 2023 and party logo.
Publisher adaptation/design credits and claimed Inclusion Europe/UNE compliance read; source attribution, not our certification or required reviewer workflow.
Full index: AP9, dependency, transport, energy, violence courts, social conditions, rights, competencies, funding, Coruña outer harbour.
Introduction explicitly says Sunday 23 July 2023, programme summary and intended audience; national self-decision context.
Congress/Senate/legislature/executive explanation; electoral pedagogy is source text, not a current legal advice service.
White Congress versus salmon Senate ballots and marking procedure. Senate details are informational and do not substitute Congress candidacy policies.
Congress/Senate group rationale and AP9 transfer to Xunta, public and free.

Dependency assistance definition and claimed 200 million euro debt payment plus quality aid for elderly/disabled people. Full programme page19 says 200million annually and >2billion accumulated; no automatic equality of quantities.

Castro A6 bridges, AP53 transfer/cheaper tolls, electrified upgraded named rail/Vigo-Portugal, Ourense-Santiago-Coruña lower fares/intercity service. Cheaper AP53 toll is less precise than main programme explicit abolition, not automatically opposition to abolition.
Lower electricity for Galicia, sustainable replacement of closed thermal plants, fair utility prices and wind-project nature safeguards. Source prices/environment effects not independently certified.
Wind public participation and no sea/coastal windmills, dedicated gender-violence courts in five named cities.
Higher minimum wage/minimum pensions, ordinary retirement at 65 and partial at 61, higher pensions and IMV funding to Galicia. No fixed 35-hour workweek or CPI formula added to this summary.
Repeated IMV definition, defend rights/repeal security law/national plurality/Franco assets recovery. General promises do not score every legal clause.
35 new competencies across listed fields; State payment of 2 billion euros each year to Galicia. Distinct from the 200 million dependency transfer on page 8.
Equal State funding for Coruña outer port/debt and current harbour land for city use; not a general ban on all port fees.
Image-only final back visually read: BNG logo, no additional policy or annex.
